q: How do I get started with my book?
a: Getting started is easy. Simply share your book idea, outline, or manuscript with our team. We'll evaluate your project, recommend the best publishing path, and guide you through writing, editing, design, publishing, and marketing from start to finish.

q: Do I need to have a complete idea before contacting you?
a: No. You don't need a completed manuscript to begin. Whether you have a rough idea, personal story, or detailed outline, our experts will help shape your concept into a professionally written and publish-ready book.

q: Will the book be written in my voice?
a: Yes. We take the time to understand your personality, writing style, and goals before we begin. Every manuscript is carefully crafted to reflect your authentic voice while maintaining professional quality and readability.

q: What services do you offer beyond writing?
a: Authors Crew provides complete book publishing services under one roof. Our services include ghostwriting, editing, proofreading, cover design, formatting, self-publishing, audiobook production, book marketing, and worldwide distribution.

q: How long does it take to write and publish a book?
a: Most book projects are completed within 3 to 6 months, depending on the book's length, complexity, and the services required. We prioritize quality, collaboration, and timely delivery throughout the publishing process.

q: Where will my book be published?
a: Your book can be published in print, eBook, and audiobook formats through leading global retailers, including Amazon Kindle, Apple Books, Barnes & Noble, Kobo, Google Play Books, and other major distribution channels.

q: Will I own the rights to my book?
a: Yes. You retain 100% ownership of your manuscript, copyright, and intellectual property. We help you publish your book while ensuring your creative work always remains yours.

q: Do you provide book marketing services after publishing?
a: Yes. We offer customized book marketing solutions designed to increase visibility, attract readers, and grow your author brand. Our services include Amazon optimization, author branding, social media marketing, book launch campaigns, and promotional strategies.
